**Nizamutdinov · 2021 · 临床**

Transcranial Near Infrared Light Stimulations Improve Cognition in Patients with Dementia

*Aging and Disease* · [DOI: 10.14336/AD.2021.0229](https://doi.org/10.14336/AD.2021.0229) · [阅读全文](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/)

阅读范围：全文方法、结果与图表。

[加入研究对比](../../research/tpbm-compare.html?selected=nizamutdinov-2021) · [按问题读](../../research/tpbm-questions.qmd)

## 怎么做

```{=html}
<dl class="tp-study-fields">
<div><dt>研究对象</dt><dd>入组60人；57人完成；早中期痴呆<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=MATERIALS%20AND%20METHODS" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·随机与设备</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>研究设计</dt><dd>随机双盲，主动:假刺激=2:1<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=MATERIALS%20AND%20METHODS" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·随机与设备</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>波长</dt><dd>1060–1080 nm<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>连续光 / 脉冲</dt><dd>方法未明确给出连续/脉冲方式<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射位置</dt><dd>头部12模块 + 2个眼部模块<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>辐照度 / 功率</dt><dd>23.1 mW/cm²；设备报告值<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>光斑</dt><dd>约650 cm²治疗区域<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射时间与疗程</dt><dd>6分钟/次，每日2次，共8周<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>剂量</dt><dd>方法未单列面剂量<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>对照怎么做</dt><dd>外观相同、不发近红外光的头盔<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>观察指标</dt><dd>MMSE等认知量表、照护者日志<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#T1-ad-12-4-954" target="_blank" rel="noopener">表 1·认知前后评分</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>测量时间</dt><dd>治疗前与末次后1天内<br><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#:~:text=Both%20active%20and%20sham" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法·头盔与照射安排</a></dd></div>
</dl>
```

## 结果怎么看

- 表1主动组MMSE由22.8升至27.6；表中p值是各组内前后检验。（[表 1·认知前后评分](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8219492/#T1-ad-12-4-954)）

## 对实验设计有什么用

组内显著、对照不显著不能替代组间变化检验；睡眠数据来自照护日志，未用睡眠脑电。
